title: Form 8 — Shifting of Residence, Correction of Entries, EPIC Replacement, PwD Marking
summary: Since the Registration of Electors (Amendment) Rules 2022 (in force 1 August 2022), Form 8 is the single form covering: shifting of residence within the same Assembly Constituency (AC) or to a different AC, correction of entries (name/DOB/photo/gender/relative's name/address spelling), replacement of a lost or damaged EPIC, and marking of PwD (Persons with Disabilities) status. The older Form 8A (within-AC transposition) and Form 001 (EPIC replacement) were discontinued and merged into Form 8.
body:
Use Form 8 for any of the following about your own existing entry:

- You moved house and want your registration updated to the new address, whether within the same Assembly Constituency or to a different one.
- Your entry has an error (spelling of name, date of birth, photograph, gender, relative's name, or address) that needs correcting.
- Your EPIC card is lost, stolen, or damaged and you need a replacement (or you simply want the free e-EPIC digital download).
- You want to be marked as a Person with Disability (PwD) in the electoral roll, which is a prerequisite for facilities like postal ballot/home voting via Form 12D at election time.

Form 8 does not cover first-time registration (Form 6), registering as an overseas elector (Form 6A), or objecting to/deleting someone else's entry (Form 7).

Since Form 8A was merged into Form 8, do not tell users to look for 'Form 8A' — direct them to Form 8 and the 'shifting of residence' option within it.
